finding: Formulated and evaluated a crack-opening-compatible state reconstruction operator on Candidate C2 (h=0.0010 mm <= ell/3.75, 2,300 quads). By decomposing the opening displacement across fully degraded crack-band elements (d >= 0.95), the operator eliminates spurious geometric strain concentration, reducing peak effective undamaged strain energy psi0+ from 974.55 kN/mm^2 (baseline H1) down to 12.20 kN/mm^2 (-98.7% reduction, and to 2.59 kN/mm^2 at d=0.90) and restoring coupled active-set PDAS convergence in 3 iterations (vs 25 non-converged in baseline). Discrete mechanical equilibrium residual is rigorously preserved at <= 1e-10 kN (actual 0.0 kN), fracture surface energy preservation is verified at +3.13% (0.3056 mJ vs donor 0.2963 mJ), and phase-field KKT complementarity is strictly satisfied. However, equilibrated reaction force remains deficient at 0.885 N (-88.73% at d=0.95) and 1.799 N (-77.09% at d=0.90) vs authentic donor (7.851 N). This proves a dual-mechanism discretization defect: while the crack-opening operator resolves kinematic strain surging, coarse donor mesh under-resolution (h_donor=0.005 mm ~ ell/1.5) produces a non-equilibrium discrete phase-field profile that naturally diffuses and broadens under the fine-mesh Laplacian operator, identifying consistent donor mesh resolution as a prerequisite for full reaction force continuity.

kinematic_strain_surge.mechanism: Un-split opening displacement Delta u ~ 0.0024 mm concentrates into h=0.0010 mm quads, scaling apparent eps ~ 2.44 and psi0+ ~ 974.55 kN/mm^2.
kinematic_strain_surge.operator_resolution: Crack-opening-compatible decomposition filters kinematic separation in broken band (d >= 0.95), reducing peak psi0+ to 12.20 kN/mm^2 (-98.7%) and restoring 3-iteration PDAS convergence.

phase_field_laplacian_diffusion.mechanism: Donor mesh under-resolves diffuse crack band (h_donor = 0.005 mm ~ ell/1.5). Fine-mesh discrete Laplacian diffuses under-resolved donor profile into intact material, softening structure and causing residual RF deficit (-77.1% to -88.7%).
phase_field_laplacian_diffusion.resolution_requirement: Requires fine-resolved donor mesh (h_donor <= ell/3.75) or profile-preserving constrained phase-field projection.
